narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The vertex is the free end of the side piece, the tip that rests behind the ear.
<bookmark mark='hinge'/>The free tip is only where one arm ends, and the two arms do not meet there.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The vertex is the one point where both arms start, and that point is the hinge.
